data.body: Operator 2026-09-30: 'can you add in the README a diagram (if github supports mermaid? if not something else) of how the default workflow works and what steps it has and commit to main'. GitHub renders ```mermaid fences natively. New section 'The default workflow at a glance' after 'Help: what it can do, and the workflow', with a TOC entry; defaults taken from config.py GatesConfig (task_pipeline, phase_pipeline, required) so the picture is the shipped default, not an aspiration.
data.title: README: Mermaid diagrams of the default workflow -- the agent loop, the ten-gate task pipeline, the phase pipeline

data.claim: GitHub renders ```mermaid fences in Markdown files; the three flowcharts are valid Mermaid and match the shipped defaults in config.py GatesConfig
data.falsifier: Mermaid validator rejects a diagram, or GatesConfig task_pipeline/phase_pipeline/required differ from what the diagrams show
data.probe: Mermaid Chart validate_and_render on each diagram; sed -n 305,345p ddflow/config.py
data.probe_output: valid=True flowchart x3; task_pipeline research..merge (10), phase_pipeline research,tasks,unit_tests,bug_hunt,dedupe,live_test,corrections,docs,merge; required implement,unit_tests,merge
